notificationDismissed.description: Owner dismissed this completed job notification; history is retained.

SeasonScheduleInput.description: Create or update the market schedule for a season. Supply exactly one start date or timestamp. End is optional; omitted end means unknown, not an infinite season.

PatchReleaseInput.description: Exactly one non-null effectiveAt or effectiveOn is required. Date-only releases await explicit confirmation.

toHeroRevisionId.description: Null when the change set was recorded from patch notes without a target snapshot.

regionCode.description: Source market for an automatically generated badge code. The code is allocated from the name and this market when code is omitted.

SkinBadgeAssignGroup.description: groupId=null unassigns; metadata updates preserve the current group.

SkinBadgeGroupView.description: Whole display group. The final virtual __ungrouped group has null id/kind/name. If matchedByGroup=true omit q when fetching children; badgeCount then covers all children. Otherwise forward q.
